findings.description: The function configuration embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key in Lambda environment variables. These values are exposed in Terraform source/state and can be read by principals with Lambda configuration access, rather than being retrieved at runtime from a dedicated secrets service.
The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security fixes. Known runtime vulnerabilities may therefore remain exploitable in the deployed function.
